amphitryon.role2Desc: Creation and management of dishes and services, stock control, and pricing.

berroyer.title: Berroyer Extranet
berroyer.subtitle: Digital workspace for commercial opportunity tracking and custom quote generation
berroyer.desc: Digital environment for managing commercial opportunities and creating customized quotes.
berroyer.intro: The Berroyer Extranet project aims to provide Berroyer's sales representatives with a robust and friendly digital environment to facilitate commercial opportunities management and custom quotes creation. This extranet enables managing opportunities, searching products, and creating tailored offers while guiding customers step by step.
berroyer.step1Desc: This step allows managing customer information:
berroyer.step1Bullet1: Search in the client list by company name, contact, or location.
berroyer.step1Bullet2: Creation of a new customer via a sliding panel with automatic saving in case of accidental closure.
berroyer.step1Bullet3: Modification of existing customer details through a similar panel.
berroyer.step1Bullet4: Selection of a customer to continue quote creation. Once selected, the customer row is highlighted in green.
berroyer.step2Desc: This step allows selecting products for the offer:
berroyer.step2Bullet1: Search products using filters (description, price, category).
berroyer.step2Bullet2: Add or remove a product from favorites by clicking on a red star.
berroyer.step2Bullet3: Hide and display prices via dedicated buttons.
berroyer.step2Bullet4: Select a product to update the offer and continue the creation process.
berroyer.step3Desc: A purely informative page displaying the technical specifications of the selected product. The 'Next' button is automatically activated.
berroyer.step4Desc: At this step, you can add options to the quote:
berroyer.step4Bullet1: Search an option by name, price, or description.
berroyer.step4Bullet2: Hover over an icon to display an option image.
berroyer.step4Bullet3: Include an option in the final PDF with several display choices (photo, description, etc.).
berroyer.step5Desc: Filling in final elements to calculate prices and generate the PDF:
berroyer.step5Bullet1: Customization of colors, delivery locations, dates, and trade-in options.
berroyer.step5Bullet2: Add discounts and calculate prices via a dedicated modal.
berroyer.step5Bullet4: Confirmation of the quote for updating and PDF generation.
berroyer.step6Desc: Summary of the quote details before finalization:
berroyer.step6Bullet1: Association of the quote with an existing opportunity or creation of a new one.
berroyer.step6Bullet2: Visualization of the final PDF with print or email options.
berroyer.step6Bullet3: Download the PDF with or without certain information (prices, discounts, conditions).
berroyer.hierarchyDesc: Following client meetings, several modifications were made to meet sales representatives' specific needs and improve the options hierarchy. The structure is as follows:
berroyer.hierarchyItem1: Option family: Corresponds to a zone on a trailer (e.g., running gear, chassis).
berroyer.hierarchyItem2: Option sub-family: Specific element of a zone (e.g., rims, spare wheel).
berroyer.hierarchyItem3: Option typology: Definition of associated parameters (e.g., brand, dimensions).
berroyer.hierarchyItem4: Article designation: Precise associated value (e.g., Berroyer brand rims).
berroyer.hierarchyItem5: Detailed article designation: Description displayed on the PDF.
berroyer.agileDesc: I participated in 3-week sprints according to the Scrum methodology, using Jira to manage tickets, track progress, and prioritize tasks. These iterations allowed meeting customer needs while respecting quality, cost, and time constraints.
berroyer.docDesc: Detailed documentation was written to guide internal users and customers in using the features. It covers installation steps, best practices, and instructions for creating and managing quotes.
berroyer.techEasyframe: EasyFrame (proprietary of GroupeFbo) framework derived from Symfony

biorelai.role1Bullet1: Create an account to access the app.

biorelai.methodText_2: This project was conducted using a collaborative methodology, with weekly task planning and regular debriefings to monitor objectives. echecs.title: Chess Game - Local Mode
echecs.subtitle: Local interactive chess game & strict adherence to official rules
echecs.desc: Interactive chess game with a clean interface, designed for a local experience faithful to the classic rules of the game.
echecs.aboutText: This project offers a chess game 100% playable locally, respecting the traditional rules and allowing a smooth and pleasant interaction. It also includes additional pages for the rules and statistics of the game, offering you a complete experience.
echecs.feature1Text: Face another player on the same device, without needing an internet connection.
echecs.feature2Text: All piece movements, checkmate, as well as pawn promotion are integrated.
echecs.feature3Text: A simple and responsive design built with Tailwind CSS for intuitive navigation.
echecs.feature4Text: Read detailed information about the game rules and relevant statistics on the games played.
echecs.tech1Text: Allows creating a dynamic and responsive interface, ideal for a game application.
echecs.tech2Text: Improves code robustness with a static type system.
echecs.tech3Text: A fast bundler for optimal development and smooth execution.
echecs.tech4Text: A utility-first CSS framework that offers quick customization and modern designs.
echecs.challenge1Text: Integration of the complex rules of the game, such as winning conditions and special movements of the pieces.
echecs.challenge2Text: Designing an easy-to-use interface while respecting playability and accessibility constraints.
echecs.challenge3Text: Ensuring that the game is fast and responsive, even with a complex game logic.
echecs.learnedText: This project allowed me to hone my skills in React and TypeScript, as well as better understand the logic behind strategy games like chess. Managing the rules and interactions between pieces was a rewarding challenge, as was creating an interface that is both simple and functional.

ysport.title: YSport
ysport.subtitle: Interactive map platform leveraging public open data
ysport.desc: Interactive mapping of sports complexes in Nouvelle-Aquitaine.
ysport.introText: The YSport project aims to make the list of sports complexes in Nouvelle-Aquitaine more accessible. Thanks to an interactive map and powerful filters, this site allows users to easily find the complexes suited to their needs.
ysport.mapText: The heart of the site is an interactive map powered by the Leaflet library. It allows users to easily search for sports complexes in Nouvelle-Aquitaine. It is possible to zoom, move the map, and click on elements to obtain more details about each complex.
ysport.filterText: The site offers several filters to search for specific complexes, such as:
ysport.filterBullet1: Filtering by city, department, or type of sport offered.
ysport.filterBullet2: Displaying only complexes with restrooms or disabled access.
ysport.filterBullet3: Possibility to sort complexes according to different criteria such as available equipment.
ysport.clusterText: To facilitate navigation, we implemented a clustering system. This system groups complexes located in the same geographic area, thereby improving visibility and management of many complexes on the map.
ysport.extraText: In addition to the interactive map and filters, several other features have been integrated into the site:
ysport.extraBullet1: Access to detailed information on each complex (address, contact, opening hours).

dovinyle.title: Dovinyle
dovinyle.subtitle: E-Commerce Marketplace & Community for Vinyl Record Collectors
dovinyle.badge: B3 Academic Capstone • Team of 4 Developers
dovinyle.desc: Designed and developed in a team of 4 during my 3rd year (B3), Dovinyle is a dedicated marketplace for vinyl enthusiasts. The platform combines a comprehensive catalog, favorites and profile management, an algorithmic hybrid recommendation engine, a secure checkout workflow with Stripe payment, and Mailjet transactional notifications. Powered by Next.js, NestJS, PostgreSQL, and containerized with Docker Compose.
dovinyle.introText: Developed within a 4-student squad, Dovinyle tackles the challenge of centralizing, showcasing, and fostering a community for audiophiles and vinyl collectors. The application delivers an exhaustive catalog for passionates and a complete e-commerce pipeline to discover, listen to, and securely purchase rare pressings.
dovinyle.archSubtitle: A containerized and decoupled architecture ensuring modularity, security, and scalability
dovinyle.archFront: Frontend built with Next.js (React), TypeScript, and Tailwind CSS, containerized via Docker, integrating Lucide Icons and reactive Toastify alerts.
dovinyle.archBack: Modular REST API powered by NestJS, organized into business domains (product, artist, order, recommendation), documented via Swagger OpenAPI, and secured with JWT.
dovinyle.archDb: PostgreSQL relational database managed via TypeORM with automated database seeding scripts and a pgAdmin management interface.
dovinyle.archServices: Secure online checkout powered by the Stripe API (Checkout Sessions), automated Mailjet transactional emails with HTML templates, and Supabase storage.
dovinyle.featuresSubtitle: A complete e-commerce ecosystem built to explore, listen, and purchase
dovinyle.feat1Desc: Intuitive browsing through vinyl records with dynamic genre filtering, artist portfolios, pressing specifications, and pricing.
dovinyle.feat2Desc: Smart algorithm combining user profile favorites and purchase history weight with an automated fallback strategy.
dovinyle.feat3Desc: One-click bookmarking, user profile customization, multiple shipping addresses, and detailed past order tracking.
dovinyle.feat4Desc: Interactive shopping cart, carrier selection, and secure online payment processing via the Stripe Checkout API.
dovinyle.feat5Desc: Automated email pipeline with HTML templates for order confirmations, email verification, and password resets.
dovinyle.feat6Desc: Curated news and articles dedicated to vinyl culture, record stores, and musical releases to engage the community.
dovinyle.mockupSubtitle: Ergonomic research and user flow prototyping in Figma
dovinyle.mockupDesc: Crafted in Figma with an immersive dark theme accented by electric cyan neons, specifically designed to emphasize vinyl album artwork and streamline the purchasing journey.
dovinyle.gallerySubtitle: High-definition overview of key application screens
dovinyle.screenCouvertureDesc: Wide showcase of the Dovinyle marketplace and its cohesive visual atmosphere.
dovinyle.screenHomeDesc: Landing page highlighting new arrivals, featured vinyl selections, and community trends.
dovinyle.screenCatalogDesc: Comprehensive exploration engine featuring precise filters by genre, artist, and release dates.
dovinyle.screenCollectionDesc: Personal dashboard to track bookmarked vinyls and favorite albums.
dovinyle.screenCartDesc: Interactive purchase validation screen with real-time price calculations before Stripe payment.
dovinyle.screenMaquetteDesc: Original design layout defining information hierarchy, component structure, and contrast balance.

cheerzup.teamSubtitle: A multidisciplinary team structured into 3 engineering squads
cheerzup.teamBackendDesc: Hexagonal architecture (DDD) design with NestJS, entity modeling, modular REST API, and Docker containerization.
cheerzup.teamFrontendDesc: Mobile application development in Flutter (Dart), interactive party game mechanics, smooth animations, and festive UX.
cheerzup.teamBoDesc: Web admin portal development in Angular for venue managers, beverage catalog management, and nightlife event tracking.
cheerzup.featuresSubtitle: An architecture crafted for smartphone players and venue operators
cheerzup.featMobileGamesDesc: A diverse collection of mobile party games (dares, cards, trivia) playable in seconds without tedious setup.
cheerzup.featMobileCardsDesc: Dynamic card draws, group challenges, mood gauges, and real-time interactive voting animated in Flutter.
cheerzup.featMobileBarsDesc: Partner venue selection during nightlife events to unlock exclusive game modes and view drink menus directly on smartphones.
cheerzup.featMobileAuthDesc: Fast Google OAuth2 login and lightweight player profiles tailored for smooth mobile nightlife use.
cheerzup.featBoVenueDesc: Angular web interface allowing managers to configure venue details, business hours, and establishment branding.
cheerzup.featBoCatalogDesc: Live editing of beverage catalogs, signature cocktails, snacks, and pricing options offered to customers.
cheerzup.featBoEventsDesc: Creation and calendar management of special events, themed parties, and sponsored activations to drive venue traffic.
cheerzup.featBoRbacDesc: Secure access management with strict separation of permissions for administrators, venue managers, and bartenders.
cheerzup.pocSectionDesc: A lightning-fast party flow designed for smartphones, launching games in seconds with immersive cards
cheerzup.pocCardWelcomeDesc: Mobile interface designed to start an instant party session and navigate between games, the bar, and the menu.
cheerzup.pocCardLoginDesc: Fast login screen integrating social authentication and profile management for evening events.
cheerzup.archSubtitle: Complete decoupling of business domain, use cases, and infrastructure details
cheerzup.archHexa: Ports & Adapters Architecture: the business core (Domain) is completely framework-independent. The Application layer orchestrates use cases, and Infrastructure hosts NestJS controllers and TypeORM repositories.
cheerzup.archBdd: Containerized PostgreSQL relational database managed with TypeORM, ensuring integrity across venues, products, events, and player profiles.
cheerzup.archAuth: Secure hybrid authentication: JWT with dedicated Guards for staff and Social Auth (Google OAuth2) for players.
cheerzup.archDocker: Full containerization via Docker Compose: synchronous orchestration of NestJS service, PostgreSQL Alpine, and pgAdmin.
cheerzup.archSwagger: Interactive OpenAPI (Swagger) documentation automatically generated, complemented by a Bruno collection for API tests.
cheerzup.archMail: Mailjet service for transactional emails, logging interceptors, global exception filters, and strict DTO validation (ValidationPipe).
cheerzup.diagramsSubtitle: High-definition visualization of application and relational architecture
cheerzup.diagramContextDesc: Bounded contexts schema structuring the application: venue management, catalog, events, player experience, and shared system services.
cheerzup.diagramBddDesc: Database table architecture orchestrating venues (Bars), staff, products, events, and player interactions.
cheerzup.moodboardSubtitle: A vibrant nightlife atmosphere combining dark tones, electric fuchsia, and purple neon highlights
cheerzup.moodboardDesc: Artistic direction designed to maximize player immersion in bars and establish a strong brand identity for CheerzUp.

locpriority.title: Location Priority
locpriority.subtitle: Order Routing & Stock Balance
locpriority.badge: Public App on Shopify App Store
locpriority.desc: Post-purchase embedded Shopify application (Shopify App Bridge) developed at Home-made.io. Automatically and dynamically reassigns fulfillment orders to prioritized warehouses and retail stores based on daily quotas, real stock availability, and advanced exclusion rules.
locpriority.introText: For merchants managing multi-warehouse networks or hybrid retail store footprints, Shopify's native fulfillment logic can overload specific distribution centers or lead to inefficient shipping splits. Location Priority intercepts post-purchase webhook events dispatched by Shopify and maps them directly to asynchronous jobs, dynamically balancing fulfillment loads via an event-sourced Stock Movements Ledger.
locpriority.archDesc: A resilient architecture combining a high-throughput event-driven backend and a native, responsive merchant UI.
locpriority.techLaravel: PHP & Laravel backend ingesting Shopify webhook events, mapped into dedicated asynchronous queue jobs powered by Redis and monitored with Supervisor.
locpriority.techReact: React & Inertia.js merchant interface embedded via Shopify App Bridge, styled with Polaris components and Tailwind CSS.
locpriority.techLedger: Event-Sourced Stock Movements Ledger with idempotency keys and strict accounting inventory audit trail.
locpriority.techRealtime: Real-time queue monitoring and live merchant updates powered by Laravel Reverb (WebSockets).
locpriority.schemaSubtitle: Post-purchase fulfillment lifecycle and real-time priority calculation
locpriority.schemaDesc: Whenever an order is placed or updated, the engine evaluates baseline location priority, physically available inventory, and the consumed daily preparation quota. As an establishment fulfills orders, its priority score dynamically decrements in favor of less-burdened sites until automatic threshold deactivation.
locpriority.gallerySubtitle: Seamless embedded experience integrated within Shopify Admin
locpriority.screenDashboardDesc: Comprehensive overview of logistics metrics: routed order volume, quota utilization warnings, daily picking counters, and integration health.
locpriority.screenRulesDesc: Centralized management of all inventory locations (warehouses & physical stores), displaying real-time routing status and active priorities.
locpriority.screenEditDesc: Per-location settings: baseline priority, maximum daily picking threshold, active status, and automated deactivation with scheduled reset cycles.
locpriority.featDynamicDesc: Continuous priority adjustments according to daily fulfillments, ensuring equitable workload distribution across fulfillment centers.
locpriority.featQuotasDesc: Daily picking ceilings with automatic exclusion from routing and scheduled reactivation at midnight or custom intervals.
locpriority.featExclusionsDesc: Selective routing bypass for pickup points (PUDO/relais carrier codes), Click & Collect, in-store POS transactions, and custom tags.
locpriority.featLedgerDesc: Auditable log recording every fulfillment decision: origin location vs reassigned location, SKU, EAN, and quantities.
locpriority.featDryRunDesc: Safe simulation mode allowing merchants to evaluate routing behavior and inspect execution logs without modifying live Shopify orders.
locpriority.featFailedJobsDesc: Supervision console for Shopify webhook events and asynchronous queue jobs, featuring one-click retry capabilities for transient failures.
locpriority.marketingSubtitle: Outreach strategy and content created to showcase the application to e-commerce merchants
locpriority.marketingYtDesc: Creation of walkthrough videos and tutorials demonstrating dynamic routing, quota configuration, and logistics simulation.
locpriority.marketingInstaDesc: Creation of promotional graphics and visual content to highlight productivity gains and multi-location inventory routing.
locpriority.marketingShopifyDesc: Execution of sponsored ads on the Shopify App Store to reach active merchants and drive app adoption.

ytellerie.title: Y.tellerie
ytellerie.subtitle: Modular Hotel System & Hexagonal Architecture
ytellerie.desc: A modular and resilient hotel management application designed by a team of 4 developers around an Angular frontend and a NestJS backend containerized with Docker, integrating Stripe and Mailjet.
ytellerie.introText: Designed as part of a software architecture course, Y.tellerie was developed by a team of 4 developers. The objective was to build an enterprise-grade, resilient hotel solution by applying the principles of Hexagonal Architecture (Ports & Adapters) and Domain-Driven Design (DDD) to strictly isolate the core business domain from infrastructure technologies.
ytellerie.team1Desc: Business domain modeling with Bounded Contexts, aggregates, and rich entities. Implementation of application Use Cases and definition of port interfaces.
ytellerie.team2Desc: Development of the Angular platform with reactive state management, HTTP interceptors for JWT tokens, and an intuitive booking tunnel for hotel guests.
ytellerie.team3Desc: Implementation of the operational hotel dashboard: room inventory management, real-time availability tracking, and staff management.
ytellerie.team4Desc: Multi-service containerization with Docker Compose, Nginx reverse-proxy, secure Stripe Checkout integration, and automated Mailjet notifications.
ytellerie.c4Desc: To ensure shared technical understanding across the team and isolate each building block, the system was rigorously documented through the C4 model and Domain-Driven Design.
ytellerie.c4BddDesc: Boundary definition separating the User/Auth context from the Hotel Core context.
ytellerie.c4BddCaptionDesc: Strict boundary between user management and hotel core operations
ytellerie.c4N1Desc: Mapping actors and external service integrations (Stripe, Mailjet) with the platform.
ytellerie.c4N1CaptionDesc: Interactions between guests, staff members, and external third parties
ytellerie.c4N2Desc: Containerized architecture: Nginx, Angular frontend, NestJS API, PostgreSQL, and Stripe CLI.
ytellerie.c4N2CaptionDesc: Multi-service container deployment orchestrated with Docker Compose
ytellerie.c4N3Desc: Internal hexagonal structure: REST controllers, application Use Cases, domain entities, and adapters.
ytellerie.c4N3CaptionDesc: Internal Ports & Adapters layout of the NestJS backend
ytellerie.cardClientDesc: Complete workflow provided to hotel guests: interactive room catalog with real-time availability filters, secure online card payment through Stripe Checkout, and automated stay confirmation.
ytellerie.screenClientDesc: Interactive room catalog with descriptions, pricing, and stay dates selection.
ytellerie.screenPaymentDesc: Secure card payment process with automated confirmation redirects.
ytellerie.screenBillingDesc: Payment summary, billing receipts, and automated transaction records.
ytellerie.cardStaffDesc: Comprehensive management dashboard for hotel operators: room inventory control, centralized booking supervision, and Mailjet transactional logs.
ytellerie.screenAdminDesc: Operational dashboard for room inventory, amenities, and cleaning status.
ytellerie.screenAdminCaption: Staff room inventory control and supervision
ytellerie.screenReservationsDesc: Centralized booking oversight, check-in/check-out tracking, and occupancy metrics.
ytellerie.screenMessagingDesc: Transactional email logs, confirmations, and operational booking alerts.
